T: Some things are worth waiting for
D: A shy 25-year-old copy editor goes back to high school undercover for her paper and gets a second shot at being seventeen.
P: Pour the pink lemonade when Josie is voted prom queen.
S: Slow-cooked pulled chicken on soft rolls, heaped with slaw. Rob crowns himself coleslaw king.

Rub the chicken with paprika and salt and pan-fry until cooked through. Shred with two forks and toss with the barbecue sauce. Toss both cabbages and the carrot with the mayo and vinegar. Fill the rolls with chicken and a big pile of slaw.
Little franks in cornmeal batter, fried on sticks.

Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then the egg and milk, to a thick batter. Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each. Dip in the batter and fry at 180C until deep golden. Drain and serve hot with mustard.
M: Deep-dish pizza with a thick tomato layer over the cheese.

Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, oregano and salt until thick. Oil a deep 25cm cake tin and press the dough up the sides. Layer the mozzarella on the base, then pinches of sausage, then the sauce, and finish with parmesan. Bake at 220C on the lowest shelf until the crust is golden and the filling bubbles.
Pork ribs slow-cooked and glazed in barbecue sauce, for The Court bonfire.

Rub the ribs with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C until tender. Mix the barbecue sauce with the honey, brush over the ribs and grill hot until sticky and charred. Char the corn on the grill, brush with butter and serve with the ribs.
W: Josie can't work out who ate her pie.

Line a pie dish with one sheet of pastry. Toss the cherries with the sugar, cornflour and lemon zest and pile in. Cut the second sheet into strips, weave a lattice over the top and brush with egg. Bake at 190C until golden and bubbling, then rest. Serve warm with ice cream.
2 x 680g jars pitted morello cherries, drained@Pantry
K: Raspberry pink lemonade over ice. The prom crown goes to someone else.
Simmer the raspberries, sugar and water until syrupy, then strain and cool. Squeeze the lemons into a jug with the syrup. Fill glasses with ice and mint, pour in the pink base and top with soda.
